I'm 41

shots.brief: crouching or sitting outdoors smiling at low-angle camera (ref: Woman in a beige trench coat and turtleneck crouching down on an outdoor wooden deck, smiling peacefully at the low-angle camera while wind blows her hair.; tripod)

audit.notes: Easily recreated with any peaceful, contemplative lifestyle b-roll clip (such as sitting in Central Park, walking, or relaxing at home) paired with reflective advice in the caption.
audit.summary: A woman crouches on a wooden pier smiling gently at a low-angle camera, paired with text hooking viewers aged 25-35 to read 11 life habits in the caption.
